'''Ngarigo''' (Ngarigu) is an extinct [[Indigenous Australian languages|Australian Aboriginal language]], the traditional language of the [[Ngarigo people]] of inland far southeast [[New South Wales]].

[[Yaithmathang]] (Jaitmathang), also known as Gundungerre, was a dialect.<ref name="AIATSIS" />
